LESSON: MY PURPOSE

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation Talents and Abilities
Topic 1.1: My Purpose

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on My Purpose. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: how I use my talents and abilities’. How do you use your God-given talents and abilities?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities
2. explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities
3. identify values required to nurture talents and abilities

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: MY PURPOSE
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 6
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
My Purpose helps you succeed in CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: MY PURPOSE
Study My Purpose like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities

What this means
In this part you learn to discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “My Purpose” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities

What this means
In this part you learn to explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to My Purpose in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Identify values required to nurture talents and abilities

What this means
In this part you learn to identify values required to nurture talents and abilities. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify values required to nurture talents and abilities.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify values required to nurture talents and abilities. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what My Purpose is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “My Purpose” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to My Purpose in your own words. (skill: explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: identify values required to nurture talents and abilities)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach My Purpose to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities.
3. Practise this skill: explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities.
4. Practise this skill: identify values required to nurture talents and abilities.
5. Make one local Kenya example of My Purpose from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for My Purpose: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 6 learner study My Purpose?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. how I use my talents and abilities’. How do you use your God-given talents and abilities?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what My Purpose means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: discuss how they use their God-given talents and abilities.
5. Be able to: explain biblical teachings on the use of talents and abilities.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
